race.description: New Crossing Place Motel & Apartments Mdn Plate
race.comment: PRINCESS OF SOL (12) sets the standard after a brave Bendigo third, beaten just under two lengths despite racing three wide without cover throughout. She has already placed around the trip and her third-up profile gives her the strongest blend of recent form and suitability. ZVEREV (4) is a genuine danger if forgiven for dropping out after leading at Yarra Valley; his prior fourth at Pakenham Synthetic was sound and Damian Lane going on is a clear positive. SOARING LEGEND (9) was steadied near the 600m before finishing fourth at Wangaratta and has scope to sharpen at his third start. WINDSOR CHARIOT (3) was tightened near the 300m at Swan Hill and comes from a leading stable at this track, up in trip should suit nicely now.
